source_refs.note: ii. Unique Solvent Abilities: a main subheading of 33.1 Properties and Quality of Water, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 247-247.

blocks.text: Polarity ki wajah se pani bohat se ionic substances ka achha solvent (gholne wala) hai, jaise metal ions, nitrates (NO₃⁻) aur phosphates (PO₄³⁻); pani ke molecules ions ko charon taraf se gher lete hain. Pani polar organic compounds bhi ghol leta hai, is liye bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se water cycle (pani ke chakkar) mein pohanch jate hain, wahan der tak rehte hain aur bioaccumulation (jaandaron ke jism mein jama hote jana) karte hain.
